bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
echo INSPECTION=VIDEO_PAID_LIVE_READ_ONLY
docker inspect "$cid" --format 'RUNNING={{.State.Running}} IMAGE={{.Image}} STARTED={{.State.StartedAt}}'
docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format 'NAME={{.Names}} ID={{.ID}}'
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/freeAlbum.mjs src/telegram/paidMedia.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs owner/gateOwner.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs; do
 echo "FILE=$p"
 docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" 2>&1 || true
done
docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'grep -nE "sendMediaGroup|sendPaidMedia|sendMessage|editMessageReplyMarkup|buildFreeAlbumRequest|buildPaidMediaRequest|VIDEO_PUBLICATION_PRE_SEND_REJECTED" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/freeAlbum.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidMedia.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -65' || true
echo INSPECTION_DONE=YES
